Timed image sequences (clean-room, MIT). Parses ISOBMFF moov with pict tracks (sample tables) plus fragmented moof/traf/trun (merged into tracks by tfhd track_ID) and builds matching non-fragmented files. Uncompressed v0/v1 and JPEG samples are decoded; video bitstreams stay Unsupported (passthrough). Layout is our own minimal profile: visual sample entries with a 78-byte header (width/height at payload offsets 24/26) followed by codec boxes (uncC etc.). Real-world files with the same header shape decode; anything else fails cleanly.

Top-level moov parse. Raises HeifDecodeError on truncation. Fragmented files (moof) have their samples merged into the matching tracks (by tfhd track_ID) in file order after the moov is parsed.
